cards.summary: large layout of loose notebook and printer paper sheets spread on a table, various pens (blue, red, purple, green, black); also includes one embroidered school patch
cards.typed_words: This item is a large multi-page planning/worldbuilding document collection by Tom Jensen for a fictional or aspirational music project/persona called "LadyWeaver," laid out together on a table for photographing. Includes: (1) A 'Saint Joseph School, Salem MA' embroidered cloth patch (blue/gold, mascot figures playing sports), photographed with number cards, unrelated object grouped with this item's paperwork. (2) 'LadyWeaver Music' notes by Tom Jensen: "Del is part of the selling point. - Tell her story - Art - Her commotion videos - Her ideas - Her writings - Her 'Enemies' or potential diggers-up of trouble in her past - Her Look/Attractiveness - Her children, family & friends - Documentaries - Don't sell Denmark Girl looks or likeness - LadyWeaver font from her handwriting. What is the Goal? - Why? - for who? 4 kids & immediate family? - WHAT do you want? - Her Legacy? Does it matter? Stay private forever? - Trust fund for young children? How much? - Royalties from music sales? - Who maintains ownership of music? Is it for sale? For how much? - Is there a # Number that would give up ALL rights to her music & ownership of it. Is that important? - Who sings/plays her music? - Is anyone worthy? - Create a star ourselves? - Start a Go Fund Me or whatever to make all her music open source/free for everyone if we reach X amount of money." (3) Track-title mapping chart titled 'Lady Weaver First album / Alanis Morissette Jagged Little Pill / Lady Weaver second album' pairing invented LadyWeaver song titles against the real Alanis Morissette album tracklist as a rhyme/structure template: May We-You Oughta Know-Human; Waltz Away-Ironic-This Way; Faith Back-Hand in my Pocket-The Big Eye; Reconcile-All I Really Want-Unfold; Time to Let Go-Head Over Feet-Aum A Cappella; Glass Hous [...cut for the check]
